problem: "||a||2 is the Euclidean length" is unreadable on a phone: without subscript markup a student reads "norm times 2", and the same length has just been defined as ||a||, so the sentence looks contradictory.
fix: Write it with a subscript tag: "The norm ||a|| = √(a · a) is the length of a; the notation ||a||<sub>2</sub> means the same Euclidean length."

where: Section 1 (Cij = Σk AikBkj, A−1A = I) and Section 3 (P(X=k) = C(n,k)pk(1−p)n−k, σXσY)
problem: Subscripts and exponents are left as plain characters, so formulas show as "pk(1−p)n−k", "Cij", "Σk AikBkj", "A−1A", "σXσY". On a phone screen these read as products of separate symbols and the binomial mass function looks wrong.
fix: Use the inline tags as the dot-product formula already does: C<sub>ij</sub> = Σ<sub>k</sub> A<sub>ik</sub>B<sub>kj</sub>; A<sup>−1</sup>A = I; P(X=k) = C(n,k) p<sup>k</sup>(1−p)<sup>n−k</sup>; ρ = Cov(X,Y)/(σ<sub>X</sub>σ<sub>Y</sub>).
